purpose: Resolve a teacher's selected Chinese grade into verified national-curriculum and revised-PEP evidence without inventing grade equivalence.
china_resolution_order: Resolve the selected grade to the China 2022 national learning stage for national curriculum context.
If PEP revised series is selected, resolve the concept through cn_pep_current_sequence_verified_2026.json plus cn_pep_unit_concept_map_2026.json and corrections.
When a matching PEP unit exists, show exact revised-series grade/semester/unit placement and retain the national learning-stage context separately.
Load below-unit detail only where the registered detail evidence supports it; do not infer subsection or page content from a unit title.
If the question concerns what is currently used in a school/locality, resolve rollout separately using locality + publisher + term when available.
Never substitute a legacy PEP sequence or ISBN for the revised series.

output_rules: Always distinguish China national curriculum stage from PEP textbook placement.
When PEP placement is verified, show grade + semester + unit rather than a generic pending label.
A verified PEP series placement does not prove every Chinese school uses PEP or that the volume is already in use in every locality.
Always name the comparison jurisdiction/framework next to its year/grade label.
Do not generate an age-equivalence claim unless a separate verified age mapping is explicitly requested and available.
A difference in timing is descriptive; do not label earlier or later as better.
